versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes.  
- No file or documentation updates in this version.  
- Version bump only; functionality and features remain unchanged.

- Initial release of review-writer skill for data-driven writing and polishing of professional workplace documents.
- Supports structured drafting and iterative refinement for reports, resumes, OKRs, PRDs, and more.
- Default workflow produces a rapid first draft with minimal questions; iterates based on feedback focusing on structure, evidence, and clarity.
- Automatically outputs in Chinese or English, supports bilingual drafts, and aligns tone and document structure to user needs.
- Includes best-practice templates for 述职/复盘, 周报/月报, 简历/STAR, OKR, and PRD/方案文档.
- Adds built-in checklists for data-driven writing, quantifiable results, and bilingual strategy.
